How much does a 1-minute AI explainer video cost?

1 finished minute (60 seconds) at 3x retries is 180 billed seconds. At the lowest rate we track, $0.0175 per second on fal (plan tier not listed, resolution 480p, audio not listed), a promo until 2026-11-15 (checked 2026-11-01), that comes to $3.15. The preset sets finished length to 1 minute (60 seconds) and leaves the multiplier, model, and resolution as they are.

How much does a 3-minute AI music video cost?

3 finished minutes (180 seconds) at 3x retries is 540 billed seconds. At the lowest rate we track, $0.0175 per second on fal (plan tier not listed, resolution 480p, audio not listed), a promo until 2026-11-15 (checked 2026-11-01), that comes to $9.45. The preset sets finished minutes to 3 and leaves the multiplier, model, and resolution as they are.

How much does a 10-minute AI short film cost?

10 finished minutes (600 seconds) at 3x retries is 1,800 billed seconds. At the lowest rate we track, $0.0175 per second on fal (plan tier not listed, resolution 480p, audio not listed), a promo until 2026-11-15 (checked 2026-11-01), that comes to $31.50. The preset sets finished minutes to 10 and leaves the multiplier, model, and resolution as they are.

How do we calculate this?

Every dollar figure on this page comes from the price rows when the site is built. API rows use the vendor's stated dollars per second. Credit-plan rows use plan price ÷ credits × credits per clip ÷ seconds, and assumes every credit you pay for is used. A promo shows its end date. An approximate row is one the vendor marked with "~", "roughly", or "estimated". The full method is on the about page (https://sheepinboots.github.io/clipcost/about/). Billed seconds are finished minutes times 60 times the retry multiplier. The estimated total is billed seconds times that row's dollars per second. A credit-plan rate already spreads the plan price across its credits.
